row: plan64 flow A row 3 - by-eye screenshots and what can be measured (question box caret vs placeholder, preset chip colour and underline, dots under the chat name, Decky plugin icon vs tab bar icon)
build_commit: 06c7553 (checkout HEAD); deployed build from flow 0 (dist/index.js sha256 34479fe9...)
pressed: walk DOWN to the question box (ring on it, no A); read styles; screenshot
UP once to the pinned Test chip; read styles; screenshot; DOWN once back to the question box; read resting styles
walk UP to the chat row; measure; screenshot
UP to Decky's back arrow, A: back to Decky's plugin list; screenshot; deck_openPlugin reopened bonsAI on the first try
screenshot of the Ask bar just after reopening (the caret was drawn in that frame)
walk UP to the tab bar so the tab strip opens; screenshot

1_question_box.how_read: getComputedStyle on .bonsai-unified-input-strategy-placeholder, .bonsai-unified-input-fake-caret (present only while the box has the ring), .bonsai-unified-input-text-overlay and the input itself
1_question_box.note: Both sizes read 12 px, so the old 10 px vs 12 px mismatch is not present. The caret sits 8 px left of and 4.3 px above the placeholder's first letter. In the screenshot taken with the ring on the box the caret is not drawn (likely mid-blink); in the one taken after reopening it shows as a thin bar at the box's top-left corner.

2_preset_chip.chip: the pinned Test chip above the question box ('how do i beat the gonarch in black mesa'; the three pinned chips rotate, later frames show 'what game am i playing' and 'how do i get across the electrified water')
2_preset_chip.underline_resting: none (resting box-shadow is only the top hairline rgba(255,255,255,0.1) and the drop shadow rgba(0,0,0,0.4))
2_preset_chip.how_read: getComputedStyle(button.bonsai-preset-glass).boxShadow on the page, with the ring on the chip and then off it
2_preset_chip.note: The 0.55 underline is the focus bar, drawn only while the ring is on the chip; at rest there is no underline at all.
2_preset_chip.screenshot: plan64-BYEYE-01-preset-chip.png (ring on the chip; the thin blue bar is visible along its bottom edge)

3_chat_row_dots.chat_name: wheatley fight (a plain row; nothing busy)
3_chat_row_dots.note: The dots start where the name's text box ends (0.2 px gap; the name's element box actually overlaps the dots by 0.19 px). In the screenshot the 'g' of 'fight' reaches down to the dots.

4_icons.steam_side_rail: Steam's own left rail in the Quick Access menu shows no bonsAI icon (7 rail icons, all Steam's: bell, friends, settings, performance, music, help, Decky plug). bonsAI's icon appears in Decky's plugin list instead, so that is what was captured.
4_icons.same_glyph: yes - both are the same bonsai-tree drawing (same view box, one path each; the code draws both from the one BONSAI_LOGO_PATH). They differ only in size (26 vs 22) and colour.

seen.also_seen: In plan64-BYEYE-01-chat-row.png, faint answer text shows through below the 'Context: no active game detected' line at the very bottom of the panel (y about 740 of 800).

verdict: NO PASS RULE (for the owner's eyes). Numbers read: placeholder 12 px, caret 12 px; underline strength 0.55 while the chip has the ring, none at rest; name-to-dots gap 0.2 px; the two icons are the same drawing at 26 px and 22 px.
